##### Project general facts

AG Ark is a contemporary residential tower designed around comfort, elegance and smart living, blending a modern architectural character with a strong focus on everyday convenience. The tower rises above basement parking levels and a ground floor and offers studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments with thoughtfully planned layouts. Every residence is a smart home, and a welcoming reception sets a refined tone for residents and visitors from the moment of arrival.

Amenities combine relaxation and social life. Residents can enjoy a swimming pool with cabanas, a fully equipped gym and an outdoor cinema with comfortable seating. A barbecue area, outdoor sitting spaces and decorative fountains create inviting places for gatherings with family and friends, while a dedicated meeting and cigar room offers a private setting for business or leisure. Round-the-clock customer support adds everyday peace of mind for residents.

Interiors feature modern living spaces, comfortable bedrooms and contemporary bathrooms finished with quality materials and a clean aesthetic. Kitchens are fitted with appliances and designed for practical everyday use. An integrated smart home system brings convenient control of the home environment to every apartment. Residences are delivered with fitted kitchens, allowing owners to furnish the space to their own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubailand Residence Complex sits at the heart of Dubailand, an expansive district that brings together residential neighbourhoods, theme parks, a polo club, hotels and a wide variety of housing. Surrounding communities include Majan, Layan, Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club, Falcon City of Wonders, Living Legends and Villanova, giving residents a broad choice of services and leisure close to home.

Dubai Outlet Mall is only a short drive away, while Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Emirates Road provide quick connections to Downtown Dubai, Dubai Mall and Dubai International Airport. Global Village, IMG Worlds of Adventure and Dubai Miracle Garden are nearby, and schools, clinics and supermarkets are available across the surrounding neighbourhoods.

Dubailand Residence Complex is a freehold area that appeals to first-time buyers, young families and investors seeking accessible entry points within a well-connected part of the city. Steady rental demand from professionals working across Dubai supports attractive yields. Continued development of neighbouring communities adds to the long-term appeal of the location.
